description: FIG ACRO Table of Difficulty 2025-2028, Women's Group balance: base positions on printed pages 58-64 (PDF 61-67), categories 1-7, reviewed by the coach 2026-11-13. `id` is how the sheet writes it ('58 C4'); page 64 holds Category 6 and 7, so the category tells its two 'A1's apart (the sheet also prints 'CAT n GR g'). `group` is the base group from its value (1: 1-8, 2: 9-13, 3: 14-17, 4: 18+), used to read the top's value. Boxes with two drawings list each as an `option` (same value); '+2' variations are separate entries with their own picture (`variationOf`). `topIncluded`: the drawing already includes the top, so no top is added (coach notes for 60 E9-E11, 61 A5-A8, 62 A7-A10, 62 D6-D10 and both Category 7 bases). `supports`: the points of support the middle can give the top (coach, 2026-11-15); the selector (still to build) will offer only top tables with a matching support drawing (see tod-wg-tops.json). Category 2 pyramids also have `supportsMiddle`: the points of support for the middle acting as a top, chosen separately; both tops' values go in A.
